prompt: An oil painting depicts a bustling subway platform scene. On the left, a man in a red scarf stands holding a silver briefcase. Next to him, a woman in a blue coat looks at a crumpled map. A brown dog sits on the bench beside her, gazing up at the ceiling lights. In the center, a child in yellow rain boots points at an approaching train. The child's mother, wearing a green hat, holds the child's hand tightly. A businessman in a grey suit checks his wristwatch impatiently. Beside the businessman, a teenager with headphones taps their foot rhythmically. A street musician with a guitar case leans against a tiled pillar. An elderly woman in a floral dress reads a thick book. A pigeon perches on the edge of the platform near a discarded newspaper. A vendor in an apron hands a hot coffee to a nurse in white scrubs. A construction worker in an orange vest talks to a police officer in uniform. On the right, a tourist with a large backpack takes a photo with a camera. A stray cat hides under a metal trash can. There is no sunlight streaming through windows. There is no digital advertising screen visible.
